text:
Visible items, using the square plate (about 26 cm) as the ruler:

| Item | Weight (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Steak / lamb slices | 90 | 200 |
| Chicken pieces | 70 | 120 |
| Roast potatoes | 80 | 120 |
| Cauliflower with leeks | 180 | 60 (including some oil) |
| Fried patty (fish or veg cake) | 60 | 130 |

That gives about 480 g and 630 kcal. I rounded the energy to 640 kcal to allow for cooking oil.
